C1630.title: Social Engineering Attack Models in Metaverse Environments: An IEEE Study
C1630.summary: A 2023 IEEE conference paper introduces a conceptual model for social engineering attacks in the metaverse. It identifies users' needs for avatars, psychological engagement, and immersion as key enablers of deception.
